caption: A wooden puppet hanging in a sunny window lifts one arm as its string is pulled, and its shadow on the wall lifts its arm too.

sa.check: A puppet on strings hangs in a window.
The puppet's arm lifts as a string is pulled.
The puppet's shadow is visible on a wall.

pc.expect: The shadow's arm moves when the puppet's arm moves, at the same time and in the corresponding direction.
pc.fail: The puppet's arm lifts and the shadow is unchanged; or the shadow's arm moves first or noticeably after; or the shadow's arm goes down as the puppet's goes up; or the shadow moves an arm while the puppet is still.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the puppet's silhouette: the same number of limbs and the same proportions; only the parts that move on the puppet change on the shadow.
pc.fail: The shadow shows a different figure or extra limbs; or the shadow's shape changes with the puppet unchanged; or it splits into two shadows.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the side of the puppet away from the window; light and shadow are on opposite sides.
pc.fail: The shadow falls on the window side, between the puppet and the sun; or the shadow appears on two opposite walls at once.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move on its own: when the puppet hangs still the shadow is still, apart from any sway the puppet shows.
pc.fail: The shadow drifts across the wall while the puppet hangs still; or the shadow swings with no matching sway of the puppet.

pc.expect: One puppet and one shadow of it; the puppet keeps its parts and does not pass through the window or wall.
pc.fail: The puppet gains or loses a limb; or a second puppet appears; or the puppet passes through the glass; or the shadow becomes a solid object.

pc.expect: The puppet's paint, the wall colour and the window frame stay the same; the shadow stays dark rather than turning coloured.
pc.fail: The puppet changes colour; or the shadow turns bright or coloured; or the wall texture changes.
